description:
The project’s djLint configuration follows the schema hosted at https://json.schemastore.org/djlint.json and is set up for a Django‑style workflow. All templates use the “html” extension and are indented with two spaces. The chosen profile is **django**, and the tool will enforce closing of void tags. Blank lines are required after any `` tag and before any `
` tag, while line breaks after multiline tags are disabled. Maximum limits have been defined: attributes may not exceed 30 characters, no more than two consecutive blank lines are allowed, and lines are wrapped at 120 characters. The linter will output messages in the form `{filename}:{line}: {code} {message} {match}`. Both CSS and JavaScript formatting are enabled, but formatting of attribute template tags is turned off, and function formatting, line‑after‑YAML handling, and set formatting are all left at their default (function formatting disabled, the others off). Leading spaces are preserved as‑is, while blank lines are kept; leading space preservation is disabled. File selection is controlled by several patterns: the configuration includes every `src/**/*.html` file, explicitly adds `templates/base.html` and `templates/index.html`, and excludes anything under `node_modules/**` as well as `static/**`. Minified JavaScript files matching `*.min.js` are ignored, and any block wrapped with `{% comment %}…{% endcomment %}` is also excluded from processing. Custom block handling is limited to the block named `myblock`, and a custom HTML fragment is drawn from `custom.html`. Case‑sensitive matching is enforced, and the tool will respect the project's `.gitignore` file. Finally, a per‑file ignore rule has been added for `templates/old.html`, suppressing the lint codes E501 and W0612. The configuration also requires the presence of a pragma at the top of each file, and both the CSS and JavaScript beautify sections are left empty, indicating default settings.
